# Funes

> Funes is a private AI assistant with a real, persistent memory. It runs on hardware the customer owns, so confidential material never leaves their premises. Made by Auto²ML.

## What Funes is

Funes is a self-hosted AI assistant built around one idea: it remembers. Tell it something today and it knows it next month, in a different conversation. Everything it remembers is visible in plain language, searchable, editable and deletable by the user — there is no hidden profile and no second copy anywhere else.

It is installed on a computer the customer owns. Paired with a language model running on that same machine, Funes works with no internet connection at all and sends nothing outside the building. Customers who prefer the extra capability of a large cloud model can choose that instead; that choice is the only thing that ever sends text out, and it is explicit.

Named after Jorge Luis Borges' story "Funes the Memorious", in which remembering everything is a curse — which is why deliberate forgetting is a controllable feature.

Current version: Funes 4.

## Who it is for

People whose work is confidential by default: law firms and solo practitioners, small medical practices, therapists and mental-health professionals, accountants, notaries and advisors, consultancies and small firms under NDA, and individuals who simply prefer their assistant to live at home.

## Features (as of version 4)

- **Persistent memory** — relevant past facts are recalled automatically before every answer, and the assistant shows what it recalled.
- **Visible, editable memory** — a panel lists everything Funes knows, tagged by source and date; users can search it, teach it facts directly, and delete any entry.
- **Deliberate forgetting** — near-duplicate memories are merged automatically and stale, never-used notes are dropped; facts taught deliberately are never pruned.
- **Document reading** — PDFs, images and text files can be dropped into the chat and discussed immediately; files stay in the user's own folder on their own disk.
- **Conversation history** — every conversation is kept and can be reopened where it stopped, or deleted outright (new in version 4).
- **Per-person accounts** — each user has their own memories, conversations, files and reminders, separated at the storage level rather than only in the interface (new in version 4).
- **Permissions** — an administrator controls which assistants and which capabilities each person can use; powerful capabilities are off by default (new in version 4).
- **Scheduled tasks and reminders** — recurring jobs run on time without the browser open.
- **Web research on request** — searches and reads the web and reports back with sources, only when asked.
- **Additional channels** — optional, opt-in WhatsApp and email integration, including reading documents sent through them.
- **Delegation to specialists** — the user always talks to Funes, which hands work to a researcher or a file/operations assistant behind the scenes.
- **Custom assistants** — new assistants can be created conversationally, with no technical work by the user.

## Privacy properties

- Runs on the customer's own hardware; no account with Auto²ML is required for it to work.
- Can operate fully offline with a local language model.
- All memory lives in a single file on the customer's disk — backup is a file copy, deletion is a file deletion.
- No hidden memory: everything stored is human-readable and user-deletable.
- Strict separation between user accounts.
- Capabilities such as command execution and network reach are disabled until explicitly granted.
- Funes supports professional confidentiality and data-protection obligations but is not itself a compliance certification.
